text:
sam: Quick sync — planning a load-run to pinpoint the regression we've seen on long-context traffic. Want to isolate kernel selection vs batching heuristics vs KV warmup.
anya: SGTM. What datasets/mix are we using? The last run was noisy.
sam: Proposal: 3-phase load harness:
1) short-only synthetic (seq 64)
2) context-mix synthetic (seq 64/512/2048 split 60/30/10)
3) prefill-dominant replays (real replay traces, prefill heavy) — 10k sessions
Also run each with identical env/quant flags and identical kernel whitelist.
kevin: Important to fix KV cache policy across runs — turn off dynamic eviction so warmup effects are consistent.
maria: Agree. Also pin continuous-batching window to 20ms for equalized comparison; avoid adaptive window during these runs.
sam: exact config snippet:
```
{"kernel_whitelist": ["int8_fused","fp16_attention"], "batch_window_ms": 20, "kv_eviction": "off", "seq_padding": "none"}
```
anya: How do we capture kernel selection decision logs? We need trace at per-request level.
kevin: perf-bot can dump kernel-choice events. @perf-bot can you attach a sample?
perf-bot: attached: kernel_decisions.log (summary below)
perf-bot: KERNEL_DECISIONS SUMMARY: 10k reqs, int8_fused: 62%, fp16_attention: 38%, avg_latency_diff: 3.8ms
maria: Those rates look off vs previous baseline — could be input distribution shift (longer prefill causing different kernel path)
sam: Exactly — that's why we do 3-phase. Also we should capture KV cache hit-rate per-token and prefill token split.
anya: For replay harness, we'll replay full session with original timing but accelerate inter-session gaps x10. That preserves prefill ordering.
kevin: Measurement checklist:
- p50/p95/p99 latency per-phase
- tokens/sec
- kernel_choice breakdown
- kv cache hit-rate over time
- memory/GPU utilization
- per-request profile flame (1% sampling)
maria: If we see regression in phase 1 (short-only) then it's batching/kernel issue; if only in phase 3, probably KV/prefill.
sam: Expected runtime: ~4h for full grid (3 seeds x 3 configs). I'll kick off later today.
anya: Add an 'equalized' control where we force kernel to baseline kernel to get a direct comparison.
kevin: command to run replay harness (quick):
```
./harness/replay --trace replay-20260214.tar.gz --accelerate 10 --config configs/context-dist.json
```
maria: One more: capture 'prefill-first-token-latency' metric — we've seen prefill token generating large tail.
sam: noted. I'll create a dashboard. tagging owners: @anya @kevin @maria. any blockers?
anya: none, will prep the trace subset.
kevin: I'll update perf-bot to include kernel-level microsecond timings.
maria: LGTM :thumbsup: 
sam: thanks — will update thread with run ids and artifacts.
perf-bot: run scheduled: id=run_20260215_42, ETA ~4h
